== Course of events ==

With the balloon's silk envelope built to rise on hot air rather than gas, Oz lights a fire beneath it to fill the balloon and prepare it for flight. In the same moment, he declares that the Scarecrow will rule in his absence, settling who is to govern the city once he is gone. The declaration comes just before the balloon is meant to carry both Oz and Dorothy away together across the desert. Instead, the ropes snap before Dorothy can climb aboard, and the balloon lifts off with Oz alone, leaving the Scarecrow to take up the rule he has just been granted while the city mourns Oz's departure.
